landing-ai_desc: Showcases AI capabilities: AI foundation and security badge, tutor, auto-grading, content generation and smart recommendations.
landing-cta_desc: Call-to-action block with login and register entries only.
landing-features_desc: Feature cards for teacher tools, student learning methods and the AI-embedded platform.
landing_hero_background_help: Accepts a CSS gradient (e.g. linear-gradient(180deg,#f0fdfa,#f8fafc)), a color value (e.g. #0f766e) or an image URL; leave empty for the default gradient background.
landing-hero_desc: Hero visual with headline, AI-era narrative, login/register CTA, studio seal and the WeChat scan-to-login module.
landing_hero_stamp_text_help: Defaults to “澜之轩工作室”; stays in Chinese on both locales.
landing_hero_story_help: When the visual infographic strip below is configured, it replaces this narrative paragraph (otherwise this paragraph is shown as fallback).
landing_hero_visuals_empty: No visual item yet (the narrative paragraph will be shown instead)
landing_hero_visuals_help: A horizontal three-column icon + short-sentence infographic; once configured it replaces the narrative paragraph above. Icons use FontAwesome classes, space-separated for several icons (e.g. fa-industry fa-plane fa-car).
landing_hero_wechat_image_help: QR code image URL (locally hosted, e.g. /bundles/clarolinemindmeai/images/wechat-qr.png)
landing-packaging_desc: Showcases packaging targets: mini-program, desktop and native app.
landing-packaging_platforms_help: Add, remove or edit platform entries (icon / name / description).
